div.div: ضَرَبٌ (S, A, Msb, K) and ↓ ضَرْبٌ , but the former is the better known, (K,) Thick honey: (A:) or white honey: (Msb, K:) or thick white honey: (S:) or, as some say, wild honey: and ↓ ضَرَبَةٌ signifies the same: or a portion thereof: (TA:) ضَرَبٌ is masc. and fem.: (S:) [for] it is said to be pl. of ↓ ضَرَبَةٌ , or a coll. gen. n., which is in most cases masc. [but is also fem.]. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
